forks.question: If On Air dies during hand-over before its result is saved, how should this part recover the unresolved hand-over?

options.says: The part retries the same hand-over request after recovery, and the hand-over part deduplicates it using the recording’s stable identity.

model.name: recording pieces

statements.name: Spec
statements.says: The recording starts in Init and changes only through a Next step.

statements.name: ProtectedClosed
statements.says: Every closed piece remains on disk until hand-over has succeeded and the three-day retention period has elapsed.

statements.name: NamesRequireFlush
statements.says: Every named piece has all its bytes flushed to disk.

statements.name: GapRecordComplete
statements.says: Every omitted piece has its duration saved before the joined file can receive its name, and that information survives recovery.

statements.name: TypeOK
statements.says: Every record field and caller observation stays within its declared type.

statements.name: ClosedNeverReplaced
statements.says: A closed piece is never rewritten or replaced, and its number is never reused.

statements.name: NumberFromNamed
statements.says: The next piece takes the number after the last piece named on disk.

statements.name: WholeAtRest
statements.says: At a piece boundary the recorded whole pieces are exactly the named pieces and no hidden piece remains.

statements.name: RecoveryRecognizesNames
statements.says: Recovery recognizes pieces named on disk even when their completion was not recorded before the crash.

statements.name: OneOpenPiece
statements.says: At most one piece is open, and its hidden remnants must be discarded before the recording advances.

statements.name: WriteFailureStopsCapture
statements.says: A failed piece write prevents that capture from accepting another piece.

statements.name: JoinHasEveryClosedPiece
statements.says: Every join is requested after capture is finalized and receives every closed piece exactly once in number order, with no piece open.

statements.name: JoinNeverReplacesNamedFile
statements.says: A whole joined file is recovered instead of being joined again or discarded.

statements.name: JoinedFileHasReadableRemainder
statements.says: A successful joined file contains all closed pieces except those reported unreadable and contains at least one piece.

statements.name: OneJoinedFileOnly
statements.says: Hand-over uses only the recording’s one joined file and creates at most one archive file for the recording.

statements.name: HandedOnlyAfterSuccess
statements.says: The recording counts as handed over only after its joined file was successfully handed over.

statements.name: FailureKeepsRecording
statements.says: A failed join or hand-over keeps every closed piece and reports the error with the spool location.

statements.name: FailedJoinHandsOverNothing
statements.says: A failed join hands over nothing.

statements.name: NoReadablePieceFails
statements.says: A join that cannot read any piece is a failure that can only proceed through retry preparation.

statements.name: RemovalNeedsRetention
statements.says: Piece removal is requested only after successful hand-over and the caller’s report that three days have elapsed.

statements.name: EmptyHasNoArtifact
statements.says: A recording with no closed pieces reports that nothing was recorded and produces nothing to join or hand over.

statements.name: HandoverRecoveryContract
statements.says: An unresolved hand-over is retried under a stable recording identity that the hand-over part deduplicates.

statements.name: ClosedPiecePossible
statements.says: A piece can be written, flushed and closed.

statements.name: EmptyPossible
statements.says: A recording can finish with nothing recorded.

statements.name: WriteFailurePossible
statements.says: A failed piece write can report that capture cannot continue.

statements.name: ResumePossible
statements.says: A paused recording can carry on after its last closed piece.

statements.name: RecoveredPiecePossible
statements.says: A piece named just before a crash can be recovered as whole.

statements.name: JoinFailurePossible
statements.says: A join can fail while the closed pieces remain available.

statements.name: UnreadableFailurePossible
statements.says: A join can fail because none of the pieces can be read.

statements.name: ManualRetryPossible
statements.says: A person’s retry request can cause a failed join to be requested again.

statements.name: LaunchRetryPossible
statements.says: A failed join can be requested again at the next launch.

statements.name: InterruptedRetryPossible
statements.says: An interrupted join can be restarted after recovery.

statements.name: InterruptionFailurePossible
statements.says: Repeated interruptions can reach the configured failure threshold.

statements.name: RecoveredJoinPossible
statements.says: Recovery can recognize a named joined file and retain its saved gap durations.

statements.name: GapHandoverPossible
statements.says: A recording can be handed over with an unreadable piece omitted and all its pieces retained.

statements.name: CompleteHandoverPossible
statements.says: A recording can be handed over with every closed piece included.

statements.name: HandoverFailurePossible
statements.says: Hand-over can fail while every closed piece stays in the spool.

statements.name: UncertainHandoverPossible
statements.says: Recovery can handle a hand-over that succeeded before its result was saved.

statements.name: CleanupPossible
statements.says: All pieces can be removed after successful hand-over and retention.

statements.name: ReleasedSourcePossible
statements.says: The hand-over part can remove the joined source after delivery without losing the recording’s saved outcome.

statements.name: JoinProgress
statements.says: Once a recording is ready to join, the part eventually requests the join unless On Air dies first.

statements.name: HandoverProgress
statements.says: Once the joined file is recognized, the part eventually requests hand-over unless On Air dies first.

statements.name: RetentionProgress
statements.says: Once retention has elapsed, the part eventually requests piece removal unless On Air dies first.

statements.name: JoinFairness
statements.says: A continuously enabled request to join eventually runs.

statements.name: HandoverFairness
statements.says: A continuously enabled request to hand over eventually runs.

statements.name: RetentionFairness
statements.says: A continuously enabled request to remove retained pieces eventually runs.

statements.name: RemoveBeforeHandover
statements.says: A mistaken implementation deletes a closed piece as soon as joining succeeds, before hand-over.

statements.name: NameBeforeFlush
statements.says: A mistaken implementation names a piece before its bytes are flushed.

statements.name: ForgetGapDurations
statements.says: A mistaken implementation loses the saved durations of omitted pieces before publishing the join.

model.module_text:
---- MODULE PieceSpool ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS MaxPieces, CutLimit, DurationValues, Spool, HandoverPolicy
VARIABLES durations, live, phase, capture, recorded, slot, named, durable, hidden,
          closed, rewritten, joinFile, joinInput, omitted, gaps,
          fileOmitted, fileParts, cuts, handed, keepElapsed, deliveries,
          handReply, handoverFile, failure, retryOrigin, notice

\* One recording is modeled; its joined pathname and hand-over identity are
\* fixed for its entire lifetime. MaxPieces bounds exploration, not production.
\* Each action that issues a command also atomically saves the entire record.
\* Disk-effect actions are caller steps, separate from recording their result.
\* Crash preserves that record and all disk facts; it loses the volatile reply.
\* closed, rewritten, deliveries, fileOmitted, fileParts and notice are ghost
\* observations used to check history and the caller's interface contracts.
\* The model does not implement file I/O, copying, decoding or a clock.
\* durations is an immutable environment fact: each piece's media duration.
\* Gap reports must agree with it; the bookkeeping does not decode pieces.

vars == <<durations, live, phase, capture, recorded, slot, named, durable, hidden,
          closed, rewritten, joinFile, joinInput, omitted, gaps,
          fileOmitted, fileParts, cuts, handed, keepElapsed, deliveries,
          handReply, handoverFile, failure, retryOrigin, notice>>

Pieces == 1..MaxPieces

Durations == durations

Phases == {"pieceReady", "writing", "naming", "discardPiece", "finishReady",
           "joining", "publishJoin", "discardJoin", "joinFailed", "joined",
           "handover", "resolve", "handoverFailed", "kept", "removing",
           "done", "empty"}

Last(s) == IF s = {} THEN 0 ELSE CHOOSE n \in s : \A m \in s : m <= n

Ordered(s) == [k \in 1..Cardinality(s) |->
                CHOOSE n \in s : Cardinality({m \in s : m <= n}) = k]

Members(seq) == {seq[k] : k \in 1..Len(seq)}

GapInfo(s) == [n \in s |-> Durations[n]]

AfterPiece == IF capture = "final" THEN "finishReady" ELSE "pieceReady"

Outcome == [status |-> CASE phase = "empty" -> "nothingRecorded"
                          [] handed -> "handedOver"
                          [] phase = "joinFailed" -> "joinFailed"
                          [] phase = "handoverFailed" -> "handoverFailed"
                          [] capture = "failed" -> "cannotContinue"
                          [] OTHER -> "pending",
            error |-> failure, spool |-> Spool, gaps |-> gaps]

ProtectedClosed == ~(handed /\ keepElapsed) => closed \subseteq named

NamesRequireFlush == named \subseteq durable

GapRecordComplete ==
    /\ (phase = "publishJoin" \/ joinFile \in {"named", "released"}) =>
          (gaps = GapInfo(omitted) /\ omitted \subseteq closed /\ omitted # closed)
    /\ joinFile \in {"named", "released"} =>
          (omitted = fileOmitted /\ gaps = GapInfo(fileOmitted))

TypeOK ==
    /\ durations \in [Pieces -> DurationValues]
    /\ live \in BOOLEAN
    /\ phase \in Phases
    /\ capture \in {"active", "paused", "failed", "final"}
    /\ recorded \subseteq Pieces
    /\ slot \in 0..MaxPieces
    /\ named \subseteq Pieces
    /\ durable \subseteq Pieces
    /\ hidden \in {"none", "partial", "flushed"}
    /\ closed \subseteq Pieces
    /\ rewritten \subseteq Pieces
    /\ joinFile \in {"absent", "partial", "named", "released"}
    /\ joinInput \in UNION {[1..n -> Pieces] : n \in 0..MaxPieces}
    /\ omitted \subseteq Pieces
    /\ gaps \in UNION {[s -> {Durations[n] : n \in Pieces}] : s \in SUBSET Pieces}
    /\ fileOmitted \subseteq Pieces
    /\ fileParts \in UNION {[1..n -> Pieces] : n \in 0..MaxPieces}
    /\ cuts \in 0..CutLimit
    /\ handed \in BOOLEAN
    /\ keepElapsed \in BOOLEAN
    /\ deliveries \in 0..2
    /\ handReply \in {"none", "ok", "error"}
    /\ handoverFile \in {"none", "joined"}
    /\ failure \in {"none", "write", "join", "unreadable", "interrupted", "handover"}
    /\ retryOrigin \in {"none", "manual", "launch", "interrupted"}
    /\ notice \in {"none", "recoveredPiece", "recoveredJoin", "recoveredHandover", "carriedOn"}

ClosedNeverReplaced ==
    /\ rewritten = {}
    /\ named \subseteq closed
    /\ phase = "writing" => slot \notin closed

NumberFromNamed == live /\ phase = "writing" => slot = Last(named) + 1

WholeAtRest ==
    live /\ phase \in {"pieceReady", "finishReady"} =>
      (recorded = named /\ slot = 0 /\ hidden = "none")

RecoveryRecognizesNames ==
    live /\ notice \in {"recoveredPiece", "recoveredJoin", "recoveredHandover"} =>
      recorded = named

OneOpenPiece ==
    /\ phase \in {"writing", "naming", "discardPiece"} => slot \in Pieces
    /\ phase \notin {"writing", "naming", "discardPiece"} =>
          (slot = 0 /\ hidden = "none")

WriteFailureStopsCapture == failure = "write" => capture \in {"failed", "final"}

JoinHasEveryClosedPiece ==
    Len(joinInput) > 0 =>
      (joinInput = Ordered(closed) /\ slot = 0 /\ hidden = "none" /\ capture = "final")

JoinNeverReplacesNamedFile ==
    phase \in {"joining", "discardJoin", "joinFailed"} => joinFile \notin {"named", "released"}

JoinedFileHasReadableRemainder ==
    joinFile \in {"named", "released"} =>
      (fileParts = Ordered(closed \ fileOmitted) /\ Len(fileParts) > 0)

OneJoinedFileOnly ==
    /\ deliveries <= 1
    /\ handoverFile # "none" => joinFile \in {"named", "released"}
    /\ deliveries > 0 => handoverFile = "joined"

HandedOnlyAfterSuccess == handed => (deliveries = 1 /\ joinFile \in {"named", "released"})

FailureKeepsRecording ==
    phase \in {"joinFailed", "handoverFailed"} =>
      (~handed /\ closed \subseteq named /\ Outcome.error # "none" /\ Outcome.spool = Spool)

FailedJoinHandsOverNothing ==
    phase = "joinFailed" => (deliveries = 0 /\ handoverFile = "none")

NoReadablePieceFails == failure = "unreadable" => phase \in {"joinFailed", "discardJoin", "finishReady"}

RemovalNeedsRetention == phase \in {"removing", "done"} => (handed /\ keepElapsed)

EmptyHasNoArtifact == phase = "empty" =>
    (closed = {} /\ joinInput = <<>> /\ joinFile = "absent" /\ deliveries = 0 /\
     Outcome.status = "nothingRecorded")

HandoverRecoveryContract ==
    /\ HandoverPolicy = "deduplicate" => deliveries <= 1
    /\ HandoverPolicy = "resolve" =>
          (live /\ phase = "handover" /\ deliveries = 1 => handReply = "ok")
    /\ phase = "resolve" => HandoverPolicy = "resolve"

ClosedPiecePossible == live /\ phase = "pieceReady" /\ named # {}

EmptyPossible == phase = "empty"

WriteFailurePossible == capture = "failed" /\ failure = "write"

ResumePossible == notice = "carriedOn" /\ named # {}

RecoveredPiecePossible == notice = "recoveredPiece" /\ recorded # {} /\ phase = "pieceReady"

JoinFailurePossible == phase = "joinFailed" /\ failure = "join" /\ named # {}

UnreadableFailurePossible == phase = "joinFailed" /\ failure = "unreadable"

ManualRetryPossible == phase = "joining" /\ retryOrigin = "manual"

LaunchRetryPossible == phase = "joining" /\ retryOrigin = "launch"

InterruptedRetryPossible == phase = "joining" /\ retryOrigin = "interrupted" /\ cuts > 0

InterruptionFailurePossible == phase = "joinFailed" /\ failure = "interrupted" /\ cuts = CutLimit

RecoveredJoinPossible == notice = "recoveredJoin" /\ phase = "joined" /\ omitted # {}

GapHandoverPossible == handed /\ omitted # {} /\ closed \subseteq named

CompleteHandoverPossible == handed /\ omitted = {} /\ closed # {}

HandoverFailurePossible == phase = "handoverFailed" /\ named # {}

UncertainHandoverPossible ==
    notice = "recoveredHandover" /\ deliveries = 1 /\ ~handed /\
      phase = (IF HandoverPolicy = "deduplicate" THEN "handover" ELSE "resolve")

CleanupPossible == phase = "done" /\ named = {} /\ closed # {}

ReleasedSourcePossible == handed /\ joinFile = "released"

JoinProgress == (live /\ phase = "finishReady" /\ recorded # {}) ~>
                  (~live \/ phase = "joining")

HandoverProgress == (live /\ phase = "joined") ~> (~live \/ phase = "handover")

RetentionProgress == (live /\ phase = "kept" /\ keepElapsed) ~>
                       (~live \/ phase = "removing")

Init ==
    /\ durations \in [Pieces -> DurationValues]
    /\ live = TRUE
    /\ phase = "pieceReady"
    /\ capture = "active"
    /\ recorded = {}
    /\ slot = 0
    /\ named = {}
    /\ durable = {}
    /\ hidden = "none"
    /\ closed = {}
    /\ rewritten = {}
    /\ joinFile = "absent"
    /\ joinInput = <<>>
    /\ omitted = {}
    /\ gaps = GapInfo({})
    /\ fileOmitted = {}
    /\ fileParts = <<>>
    /\ cuts = 0
    /\ handed = FALSE
    /\ keepElapsed = FALSE
    /\ deliveries = 0
    /\ handReply = "none"
    /\ handoverFile = "none"
    /\ failure = "none"
    /\ retryOrigin = "none"
    /\ notice = "none"

OpenPiece ==
    /\ live
    /\ phase = "pieceReady"
    /\ capture = "active"
    /\ slot = 0
    /\ hidden = "none"
    /\ Last(recorded) < MaxPieces
    /\ phase' = "writing"
    /\ slot' = Last(recorded) + 1
    /\ notice' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<durations, live, capture, recorded, named, durable, hidden, closed, rewritten, joinFile, joinInput, omitted, gaps, fileOmitted, fileParts, cuts, handed, keepElapsed, deliveries, handReply, handoverFile, failure, retryOrigin>>

WritePartial ==
    /\ live
    /\ phase = "writing"
    /\ hidden = "none"
    /\ hidden' = "partial"
    /\ notice' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<durations, live, phase, capture, recorded, slot, named, durable, closed, rewritten, joinFile, joinInput, omitted, gaps, fileOmitted, fileParts, cuts, handed, keepElapsed, deliveries, handReply, handoverFile, failure, retryOrigin>>

FlushPiece ==
    /\ live
    /\ phase = "writing"
    /\ hidden \in {"none", "partial"}
    /\ hidden' = "flushed"
    /\ durable' = durable \cup {slot}
    /\ notice' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<durations, live, phase, capture, recorded, slot, named, closed, rewritten, joinFile, joinInput, omitted, gaps, fileOmitted, fileParts, cuts, handed, keepElapsed, deliveries, handReply, handoverFile, failure, retryOrigin>>

SaveFlushAndRequestName ==
    /\ live
    /\ phase = "writing"
    /\ hidden = "flushed"
    /\ phase' = "naming"
    /\ notice' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<durations, live, capture, recorded, slot, named, durable, hidden, closed, rewritten, joinFile, joinInput, omitted, gaps, fileOmitted, fileParts, cuts, handed, keepElapsed, deliveries, handReply, handoverFile, failure, retryOrigin>>

NamePiece ==
    /\ live
    /\ phase = "naming"
    /\ hidden = "flushed"
    /\ slot \notin named
    /\ named' = named \cup {slot}
    /\ closed' = closed \cup {slot}
    /\ hidden' = "none"
    /\ rewritten' = rewritten \cup (named \cap {slot})
    /\ notice' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<durations, live, phase, capture, recorded, slot, durable, joinFile, joinInput, omitted, gaps, fileOmitted, fileParts, cuts, handed, keepElapsed, deliveries, handReply, handoverFile, failure, retryOrigin>>

SaveNamedPiece ==
    /\ live
    /\ phase = "naming"
    /\ slot \in named
    /\ recorded' = named
    /\ slot' = 0
    /\ phase' = AfterPiece
    /\ notice' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<durations, live, capture, named, durable, hidden, closed, rewritten, joinFile, joinInput, omitted, gaps, fileOmitted, fileParts, cuts, handed, keepElapsed, deliveries, handReply, handoverFile, failure, retryOrigin>>

WriteFailed ==
    /\ live
    /\ phase = "writing"
    /\ capture' = IF capture = "final" THEN "final" ELSE "failed"
    /\ phase' = "discardPiece"
    /\ failure' = "write"
    /\ notice' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<durations, live, recorded, slot, named, durable, hidden, closed, rewritten, joinFile, joinInput, omitted, gaps, fileOmitted, fileParts, cuts, handed, keepElapsed, deliveries, handReply, handoverFile, retryOrigin>>

DiscardHiddenPiece ==
    /\ live
    /\ phase = "discardPiece"
    /\ hidden # "none"
    /\ hidden' = "none"
    /\ durable' = durable \ {slot}
    /\ notice' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<durations, live, phase, capture, recorded, slot, named, closed, rewritten, joinFile, joinInput, omitted, gaps, fileOmitted, fileParts, cuts, handed, keepElapsed, deliveries, handReply, handoverFile, failure, retryOrigin>>

SaveDiscardedPiece ==
    /\ live
    /\ phase = "discardPiece"
    /\ hidden = "none"
    /\ slot' = 0
    /\ phase' = AfterPiece
    /\ notice' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<durations, live, capture, recorded, named, durable, hidden, closed, rewritten, joinFile, joinInput, omitted, gaps, fileOmitted, fileParts, cuts, handed, keepElapsed, deliveries, handReply, handoverFile, failure, retryOrigin>>

CaptureEnded ==
    /\ live
    /\ capture = "active"
    /\ phase \in {"pieceReady", "writing", "naming"}
    /\ capture' = "paused"
    /\ notice' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<durations, live, phase, recorded, slot, named, durable, hidden, closed, rewritten, joinFile, joinInput, omitted, gaps, fileOmitted, fileParts, cuts, handed, keepElapsed, deliveries, handReply, handoverFile, failure, retryOrigin>>

CarryOn ==
    /\ live
    /\ capture = "paused"
    /\ phase = "pieceReady"
    /\ capture' = "active"
    /\ notice' = "carriedOn"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<durations, live, phase, recorded, slot, named, durable, hidden, closed, rewritten, joinFile, joinInput, omitted, gaps, fileOmitted, fileParts, cuts, handed, keepElapsed, deliveries, handReply, handoverFile, failure, retryOrigin>>

FinishCapture ==
    /\ live
    /\ capture # "final"
    /\ phase \in {"pieceReady", "writing", "naming", "discardPiece"}
    /\ capture' = "final"
    /\ phase' = IF phase = "pieceReady" THEN "finishReady" ELSE phase
    /\ notice' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<durations, live, recorded, slot, named, durable, hidden, closed, rewritten, joinFile, joinInput, omitted, gaps, fileOmitted, fileParts, cuts, handed, keepElapsed, deliveries, handReply, handoverFile, failure, retryOrigin>>

ReportEmpty ==
    /\ live
    /\ phase = "finishReady"
    /\ recorded = {}
    /\ phase' = "empty"
    /\ notice' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<durations, live, capture, recorded, slot, named, durable, hidden, closed, rewritten, joinFile, joinInput, omitted, gaps, fileOmitted, fileParts, cuts, handed, keepElapsed, deliveries, handReply, handoverFile, failure, retryOrigin>>

RequestJoin ==
    /\ live
    /\ phase = "finishReady"
    /\ recorded # {}
    /\ slot = 0
    /\ hidden = "none"
    /\ joinFile = "absent"
    /\ phase' = "joining"
    /\ joinInput' = Ordered(named)
    /\ omitted' = {}
    /\ gaps' = GapInfo({})
    /\ failure' = "none"
    /\ notice' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<durations, live, capture, recorded, slot, named, durable, hidden, closed, rewritten, joinFile, fileOmitted, fileParts, cuts, handed, keepElapsed, deliveries, handReply, handoverFile, retryOrigin>>

WritePartialJoin ==
    /\ live
    /\ phase = "joining"
    /\ joinFile = "absent"
    /\ joinFile' = "partial"
    /\ notice' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<durations, live, phase, capture, recorded, slot, named, durable, hidden, closed, rewritten, joinInput, omitted, gaps, fileOmitted, fileParts, cuts, handed, keepElapsed, deliveries, handReply, handoverFile, failure, retryOrigin>>

\* F1=B: the omission report and durations are saved before publication is requested.

SaveJoinReadResult(bad) ==
    /\ live
    /\ phase = "joining"
    /\ joinFile = "partial"
    /\ bad \subseteq Members(joinInput)
    /\ phase' = IF bad = Members(joinInput) THEN "joinFailed" ELSE "publishJoin"
    /\ failure' = IF bad = Members(joinInput) THEN "unreadable" ELSE "none"
    /\ omitted' = IF bad = Members(joinInput) THEN {} ELSE bad
    /\ gaps' = IF bad = Members(joinInput) THEN GapInfo({}) ELSE GapInfo(bad)
    /\ notice' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<durations, live, capture, recorded, slot, named, durable, hidden, closed, rewritten, joinFile, joinInput, fileOmitted, fileParts, cuts, handed, keepElapsed, deliveries, handReply, handoverFile, retryOrigin>>

JoinFailed ==
    /\ live
    /\ phase = "joining"
    /\ phase' = "joinFailed"
    /\ failure' = "join"
    /\ notice' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<durations, live, capture, recorded, slot, named, durable, hidden, closed, rewritten, joinFile, joinInput, omitted, gaps, fileOmitted, fileParts, cuts, handed, keepElapsed, deliveries, handReply, handoverFile, retryOrigin>>

NameJoinedFile ==
    /\ live
    /\ phase = "publishJoin"
    /\ joinFile = "partial"
    /\ joinFile' = "named"
    /\ fileOmitted' = omitted
    /\ fileParts' = Ordered(Members(joinInput) \ omitted)
    /\ notice' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<durations, live, phase, capture, recorded, slot, named, durable, hidden, closed, rewritten, joinInput, omitted, gaps, cuts, handed, keepElapsed, deliveries, handReply, handoverFile, failure, retryOrigin>>

SaveNamedJoin ==
    /\ live
    /\ phase = "publishJoin"
    /\ joinFile = "named"
    /\ phase' = "joined"
    /\ cuts' = 0
    /\ notice' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<durations, live, capture, recorded, slot, named, durable, hidden, closed, rewritten, joinFile, joinInput, omitted, gaps, fileOmitted, fileParts, handed, keepElapsed, deliveries, handReply, handoverFile, failure, retryOrigin>>

PersonRequestsRetry ==
    /\ live
    /\ phase = "joinFailed"
    /\ phase' = IF joinFile = "partial" THEN "discardJoin" ELSE "finishReady"
    /\ cuts' = 0
    /\ retryOrigin' = "manual"
    /\ notice' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<durations, live, capture, recorded, slot, named, durable, hidden, closed, rewritten, joinFile, joinInput, omitted, gaps, fileOmitted, fileParts, handed, keepElapsed, deliveries, handReply, handoverFile, failure>>

DiscardPartialJoin ==
    /\ live
    /\ phase = "discardJoin"
    /\ joinFile = "partial"
    /\ joinFile' = "absent"
    /\ notice' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<durations, live, phase, capture, recorded, slot, named, durable, hidden, closed, rewritten, joinInput, omitted, gaps, fileOmitted, fileParts, cuts, handed, keepElapsed, deliveries, handReply, handoverFile, failure, retryOrigin>>

SaveDiscardedJoin ==
    /\ live
    /\ phase = "discardJoin"
    /\ joinFile = "absent"
    /\ phase' = "finishReady"
    /\ notice' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<durations, live, capture, recorded, slot, named, durable, hidden, closed, rewritten, joinFile, joinInput, omitted, gaps, fileOmitted, fileParts, cuts, handed, keepElapsed, deliveries, handReply, handoverFile, failure, retryOrigin>>

RequestHandover ==
    /\ live
    /\ phase = "joined"
    /\ joinFile = "named"
    /\ phase' = "handover"
    /\ handoverFile' = "joined"
    /\ notice' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<durations, live, capture, recorded, slot, named, durable, hidden, closed, rewritten, joinFile, joinInput, omitted, gaps, fileOmitted, fileParts, cuts, handed, keepElapsed, deliveries, handReply, failure, retryOrigin>>

\* Option A permits replay, with the same recording identity; the caller deduplicates.
\* Option B permits no replay of an unresolved hand-over; the caller resolves it.

CallerHandsOver ==
    /\ live
    /\ phase = "handover"
    /\ handReply = "none"
    /\ HandoverPolicy = "deduplicate" \/ deliveries = 0
    /\ deliveries' = 1
    /\ handReply' = "ok"
    /\ notice' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<durations, live, phase, capture, recorded, slot, named, durable, hidden, closed, rewritten, joinFile, joinInput, omitted, gaps, fileOmitted, fileParts, cuts, handed, keepElapsed, handoverFile, failure, retryOrigin>>

CallerHandoverFails ==
    /\ live
    /\ phase = "handover"
    /\ handReply = "none"
    /\ deliveries = 0
    /\ handReply' = "error"
    /\ notice' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<durations, live, phase, capture, recorded, slot, named, durable, hidden, closed, rewritten, joinFile, joinInput, omitted, gaps, fileOmitted, fileParts, cuts, handed, keepElapsed, deliveries, handoverFile, failure, retryOrigin>>

SaveHandoverSuccess ==
    /\ live
    /\ phase = "handover"
    /\ handReply = "ok"
    /\ phase' = "kept"
    /\ handed' = TRUE
    /\ handReply' = "none"
    /\ failure' = "none"
    /\ notice' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<durations, live, capture, recorded, slot, named, durable, hidden, closed, rewritten, joinFile, joinInput, omitted, gaps, fileOmitted, fileParts, cuts, keepElapsed, deliveries, handoverFile, retryOrigin>>

SaveHandoverFailure ==
    /\ live
    /\ phase = "handover"
    /\ handReply = "error"
    /\ phase' = "handoverFailed"
    /\ handReply' = "none"
    /\ failure' = "handover"
    /\ notice' = "none"

pins.name: ProtectedClosed

pins.name: ClosedNeverReplaced
pins.says: A closed piece is never rewritten or replaced, and its number is never reused.

pins.name: NumberFromNamed
pins.says: The next piece takes the number after the last piece named on disk.

pins.name: WholeAtRest
pins.says: At a piece boundary the recorded whole pieces are exactly the named pieces and no hidden piece remains.

pins.name: RecoveryRecognizesNames
pins.says: Recovery recognizes pieces named on disk even when their completion was not recorded before the crash.

pins.name: OneOpenPiece
pins.says: At most one piece is open, and its hidden remnants must be discarded before the recording advances.

pins.name: WriteFailureStopsCapture
pins.says: A failed piece write prevents that capture from accepting another piece.

pins.name: JoinHasEveryClosedPiece
pins.says: Every join is requested after capture is finalized and receives every closed piece exactly once in number order, with no piece open.

pins.name: JoinNeverReplacesNamedFile
pins.says: A whole joined file is recovered instead of being joined again or discarded.

pins.name: JoinedFileHasReadableRemainder
pins.says: A successful joined file contains all closed pieces except those reported unreadable and contains at least one piece.

pins.says: Hand-over uses only the recording’s one joined file and creates at most one archive file for the recording.

pins.name: HandedOnlyAfterSuccess
pins.says: The recording counts as handed over only after its joined file was successfully handed over.

pins.name: FailureKeepsRecording

pins.name: FailedJoinHandsOverNothing

pins.says: A join that cannot read any piece is a failure that can only proceed through retry preparation.

pins.name: RemovalNeedsRetention

pins.name: EmptyHasNoArtifact

---- MODULE PieceSpool ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS MaxPieces, CutLimit, DurationValues, Spool, HandoverPolicy
VARIABLES durations, live, phase, capture, recorded, slot, named, durable, hidden,
          closed, rewritten, joinFile, joinInput, omitted, gaps,
          fileOmitted, fileParts, cuts, handed, keepElapsed, deliveries,
          handReply, handoverFile, failure, retryOrigin, notice

\* One recording is modeled; its joined pathname and hand-over identity are
\* fixed for its entire lifetime. MaxPieces bounds exploration, not production.
\* Each action that issues a command also atomically saves the entire record.
\* Disk-effect actions are caller steps, separate from recording their result.
\* Crash preserves that record and all disk facts; it loses the volatile reply.
\* closed, rewritten, deliveries, fileOmitted, fileParts and notice are ghost
\* observations used to check history and the caller's interface contracts.
\* The model does not implement file I/O, copying, decoding or a clock.
\* durations is an immutable environment fact: each piece's media duration.
\* Gap reports must agree with it; the bookkeeping does not decode pieces.

Pieces == 1..MaxPieces

Durations == durations

Phases == {"pieceReady", "writing", "naming", "discardPiece", "finishReady",
           "joining", "publishJoin", "discardJoin", "joinFailed", "joined",
           "handover", "resolve", "handoverFailed", "kept", "removing",
           "done", "empty"}

Last(s) == IF s = {} THEN 0 ELSE CHOOSE n \in s : \A m \in s : m <= n

Ordered(s) == [k \in 1..Cardinality(s) |->
                CHOOSE n \in s : Cardinality({m \in s : m <= n}) = k]

Members(seq) == {seq[k] : k \in 1..Len(seq)}

GapInfo(s) == [n \in s |-> Durations[n]]

AfterPiece == IF capture = "final" THEN "finishReady" ELSE "pieceReady"

Outcome == [status |-> CASE phase = "empty" -> "nothingRecorded"
                          [] handed -> "handedOver"
                          [] phase = "joinFailed" -> "joinFailed"
                          [] phase = "handoverFailed" -> "handoverFailed"
                          [] capture = "failed" -> "cannotContinue"
                          [] OTHER -> "pending",
            error |-> failure, spool |-> Spool, gaps |-> gaps]

ProtectedClosed == ~(handed /\ keepElapsed) => closed \subseteq named

NamesRequireFlush == named \subseteq durable

GapRecordComplete ==
    /\ (phase = "publishJoin" \/ joinFile \in {"named", "released"}) =>
          (gaps = GapInfo(omitted) /\ omitted \subseteq closed /\ omitted # closed)
    /\ joinFile \in {"named", "released"} =>
          (omitted = fileOmitted /\ gaps = GapInfo(fileOmitted))

TypeOK ==
    /\ durations \in [Pieces -> DurationValues]
    /\ live \in BOOLEAN
    /\ phase \in Phases
    /\ capture \in {"active", "paused", "failed", "final"}
    /\ recorded \subseteq Pieces
    /\ slot \in 0..MaxPieces
    /\ named \subseteq Pieces
    /\ durable \subseteq Pieces
    /\ hidden \in {"none", "partial", "flushed"}
    /\ closed \subseteq Pieces
    /\ rewritten \subseteq Pieces
    /\ joinFile \in {"absent", "partial", "named", "released"}
    /\ joinInput \in UNION {[1..n -> Pieces] : n \in 0..MaxPieces}
    /\ omitted \subseteq Pieces
    /\ gaps \in UNION {[s -> {Durations[n] : n \in Pieces}] : s \in SUBSET Pieces}
    /\ fileOmitted \subseteq Pieces
    /\ fileParts \in UNION {[1..n -> Pieces] : n \in 0..MaxPieces}
    /\ cuts \in 0..CutLimit
    /\ handed \in BOOLEAN
    /\ keepElapsed \in BOOLEAN
    /\ deliveries \in 0..2
    /\ handReply \in {"none", "ok", "error"}
    /\ handoverFile \in {"none", "joined"}
    /\ failure \in {"none", "write", "join", "unreadable", "interrupted", "handover"}
    /\ retryOrigin \in {"none", "manual", "launch", "interrupted"}
    /\ notice \in {"none", "recoveredPiece", "recoveredJoin", "recoveredHandover", "carriedOn"}

    /\ rewritten = {}
    /\ named \subseteq closed
    /\ phase = "writing" => slot \notin closed

NumberFromNamed == live /\ phase = "writing" => slot = Last(named) + 1

    live /\ phase \in {"pieceReady", "finishReady"} =>
      (recorded = named /\ slot = 0 /\ hidden = "none")

RecoveryRecognizesNames ==
    live /\ notice \in {"recoveredPiece", "recoveredJoin", "recoveredHandover"} =>
      recorded = named

    /\ phase \in {"writing", "naming", "discardPiece"} => slot \in Pieces
    /\ phase \notin {"writing", "naming", "discardPiece"} =>
          (slot = 0 /\ hidden = "none")

pins.name: Spec
pins.says: The recording starts in Init and changes only through a Next step.

pins.name: ProtectedClosed
pins.says: Every closed piece remains on disk until hand-over has succeeded and the three-day retention period has elapsed.

pins.name: NamesRequireFlush
pins.says: Every named piece has all its bytes flushed to disk.

pins.name: GapRecordComplete
pins.says: Every omitted piece has its duration saved before the joined file can receive its name, and that information survives recovery.

pins.name: TypeOK
pins.says: Every record field and caller observation stays within its declared type.

pins.name: ClosedNeverReplaced
pins.says: A closed piece is never rewritten or replaced, and its number is never reused.

pins.name: NumberFromNamed
pins.says: The next piece takes the number after the last piece named on disk.

pins.name: WholeAtRest
pins.says: At a piece boundary the recorded whole pieces are exactly the named pieces and no hidden piece remains.

pins.name: RecoveryRecognizesNames
pins.says: Recovery recognizes pieces named on disk even when their completion was not recorded before the crash.

pins.name: OneOpenPiece
pins.says: At most one piece is open, and its hidden remnants must be discarded before the recording advances.

pins.name: WriteFailureStopsCapture
pins.says: A failed piece write prevents that capture from accepting another piece.

pins.name: JoinHasEveryClosedPiece
pins.says: Every join is requested after capture is finalized and receives every closed piece exactly once in number order, with no piece open.

pins.name: JoinNeverReplacesNamedFile
pins.says: A whole joined file is recovered instead of being joined again or discarded.

pins.name: JoinedFileHasReadableRemainder
pins.says: A successful joined file contains all closed pieces except those reported unreadable and contains at least one piece.

pins.name: OneJoinedFileOnly
pins.says: Hand-over uses only the recording’s one joined file and creates at most one archive file for the recording.

pins.name: HandedOnlyAfterSuccess
pins.says: The recording counts as handed over only after its joined file was successfully handed over.

pins.name: FailureKeepsRecording
pins.says: A failed join or hand-over keeps every closed piece and reports the error with the spool location.

pins.name: FailedJoinHandsOverNothing
pins.says: A failed join hands over nothing.

pins.name: NoReadablePieceFails
pins.says: A join that cannot read any piece is a failure that can only proceed through retry preparation.

pins.name: RemovalNeedsRetention
pins.says: Piece removal is requested only after successful hand-over and the caller’s report that three days have elapsed.

pins.name: EmptyHasNoArtifact
pins.says: A recording with no closed pieces reports that nothing was recorded and produces nothing to join or hand over.

pins.name: HandoverRecoveryContract
pins.says: An unresolved hand-over is reconciled by the caller after recovery before any hand-over can be requested again.

pins.name: ClosedPiecePossible
pins.says: A piece can be written, flushed and closed.

pins.name: EmptyPossible
